headline: Approve only with a staged rollout

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.body: The plan {{npv}} is positive, but {{npv_flows_minus_10}} turns negative if the savings come in light. Approve with conditions rather than defer: stage the rollout, and hold a labor-savings checkpoint before expanding.

conditions: Stage the rollout and do not expand until the early cell is stable.
Hold a labor-savings checkpoint before the second phase, using {{npv_flows_minus_10}} as the stress test.
disagreements_addressed: The CFO would defer because the lighter cash-flow case is negative. Operations asked for a checkpoint. The base case still supports going ahead if those conditions are met.
